study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Elad et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Improving the predictive potential of diffusion MRI in schizophrenia using normative models -Towards subject-level classification

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses a harmonized dataset from 13 sites. One is explicitly named as the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC). The others are provided by principal investigators and are treated as a multi-site collection.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The dataset used in this study coincides with the dataset utilized in the published work by (Cetin-Karayumak et al., 2020)... dMRI data were collated from 13 different sites... All data, except for the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC)... were provided by the principal investigators... PNC data were downloaded...
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Elad2021.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Participants, imaging acquisition, image preprocessing and harmonization procedures

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Data from all sites (including PNC) were harmonized and used in a 10-fold cross-validation scheme. In each fold, 90% of controls were used to build the normative model (training) and the rest for testing/classification.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The data were partitioned into 10 subsets... In each cross-validation round, one of the 10 subsets served as the test set, while the other 9 subsets served as the training set... In each cross-validation, the normative range... were estimated using only the healthy control subjects that belonged to the corresponding training set.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Elad2021.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Prediction models

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: 512 healthy controls in total. Normative models constructed using 10-fold cross-validation.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: We leveraged a large harmonized diffusion MRI dataset from 512 healthy controls and 601 individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia... In each cross-validation, the normative range... were estimated using only the healthy control subjects that belonged to the corresponding training set.
